facts.text: The user has a virtual room where two users are paired.
The user uses WebRTC for the virtual room.
The user has a Google Cloud account with an API key for transcription.
The user uses Angular on AWS.
The user wants a solution that sends audio from the client browser to Google and then back to the browser.
The user asked for detailed steps for items 3 and 4 including code.
The user wants to know whether the proposed solution would work on all mobile devices.
The user wants to capture the audio stream on the moderator side using a PC versus a mobile device.
The user wants to send both streams to Google for transcription.
